content.title: How to watch Mariners vs. Angels: TV channel and streaming options for April 3
content.text: The Seattle Mariners and Los Angeles Angels square off in the first of a three-game series on Friday at Angel Stadium, at 9:38 p.m. ET. Bryan Woo (0-0, 3.00 ERA) gets the start for the Mariners, who are 3-4 this season and fourth in the AL West. Reid Detmers (0-0, 5.79 ERA) is expected to start for the Angels, who are 3-4 and third in the AL West.How to watch Seattle Mariners vs. Los Angeles Angels Venue: Angel Stadium Time: 9:38 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: FDSW and Mariners.TV Watching in person? He has a 24.2% strikeout rate and a 30.3% walk rate in 33 plate appearances, and he has scored six total runs. Trout has recorded two steals on two attempts. In 33 plate appearances, Zach Neto has slashed .231/.394/.500 this season. He has hit two long balls (16th in MLB) and driven in three runs with a strikeout rate of 21.2% and a walk rate of 21.2%. He has stolen one base on two attempts and has scored seven runs (5th in MLB).
